Way 1

1-to-1 Therapies

Tailored sessions for physical and emotional wellbeing

I offer personalised treatments combining therapeutic massage, including deep tissue, sports, remedial and lymphatic drainage, reflexology, and Biofield Tuning. These sessions support people dealing with stress, fatigue, pain, or emotional overwhelm — helping you release what's stuck and feel more at ease in your body.

Deep Tissue and Sports Massage

Massage concentrates on the deep layers of muscle and fascia in the body. Used to treat a variety of ailments, reducing chronic pain, improving blood pressure, rehabilitating injured muscles and helping to relieve the physical symptoms of stress. Massage is also very effective for injury prevention.

  • Sports & Remedial
  • Deep Tissue
  • Therapeutic
  • Lymphatic Drainage
  • Fascia Release (gentle)
  • Cupping Therapy

Clinical Reflexology

Reflexology is based on the principle that there are reflex areas in the feet and hands which correspond to all of the organs, glands, and parts of the body. Stimulating these reflexes properly can help many health problems in a natural way. Helping to reduce pain and tension in the body.

Biofield Tuning Fork Therapy

Biofield Tuning Fork Therapy is a process that uses tuning forks to locate and correct distortions in the body's energy field, or biofield. This therapy is a simple, effective and powerful healing modality that can help bring the body back into balance and release past emotions bringing healing and wellbeing.

  • Biofield Tuning Sound Therapy
  • Chakra balancing

Clinics in Marlow, Cressex and Burnham.

Nina Earl

About

Who I Am and What I Do

I'm a multi disciplined sound and body therapist, independent researcher in the field archaeoacoustics and member of SB research group. I am passionate about helping people to overcome health challenges, whether that be due to injury, stress or emotional conditions like anxiety. I bring a depth of compassion and empathy to my work that enables me to remain non-judgemental. Every session is tailor-made and unique, taking into account age, lifestyle factors, mobility and personal goals. My aim is to work with you to identify and address root causes of any wellbeing issues.

My background has been working in the NHS on the frontline of adult social care, settings included GP surgeries, and mental health. With almost 20 years experience of supporting people with physical and emotional health conditions, I have gained insight into the value of early intervention as well as sound mitigation strategies. Indeed it was sound that helped me to overcome my own PTSD, hence my passion for studying it and integrating it into most of my treatments.

I offer individual sessions in a number of Massage therapies (including Sports, Remedial, Therapeutic, Deep Tissue and Lymphatic Drainage), Reflexology, and Biofield Tuning Sound Therapy. I am passionate about therapies that work on an emotional, mental, and physical level at the same time, which led to me training with sound pioneer Eileen McKusick in Biofield Tuning sound therapy. I have spoken at international conferences and local events, and offer workshops and talks on a number of topics including, the human Biofield, intention, electric health and archaeoacoustics.

My clinics are located at the Marlow Club, Marlow; Alevia Clinic, Cressex and Nailtalk, Burnham. I offer day time and evening and Saturday appointments.
